body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

Jasco has introduced its new 1.3 mega pixels laptop camera. It will be available in February of 2006 and it will cost about 29(USD). This is a prize-winning product of the Innovations design and engineering showcase award. Jasco received total 8 awards at CES 2006.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
